tier3_constraints.constraint_text: The system must ensure double-entry bookkeeping principles are followed
tier3_constraints.reasoning: Ensuring double-entry bookkeeping principles requires data consistency and correctness, which are core reliability concerns (maturity, fault tolerance). This prevents data corruption and ensures the system behaves correctly under all conditions.

tier3_constraints.constraint_text: maintain an audit trail of all transactions
tier3_constraints.reasoning: Audit trails are directly related to auditability and integrity guarantees, which are core trustworthiness concerns. This ensures all transactions can be traced and verified.

tier3_constraints.constraint_text: maintain an audit trail of all transactions
tier3_constraints.reasoning: Audit trails support non-repudiation and integrity concerns, ensuring that transaction records cannot be tampered with and changes can be attributed to specific users.

tier3_constraints.constraint_text: record financial transactions including income and expenses
tier3_constraints.reasoning: Financial transaction data is sensitive personal information that requires data minimization, consent management, and protection of data subject rights under GDPR.

tier3_constraints.constraint_text: Users must be able to generate financial reports such as balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements
tier3_constraints.reasoning: Report generation can be resource-intensive and time-sensitive. Performance concerns include time behaviour for report generation and resource utilization when processing large transaction datasets.

tier3_constraints.constraint_text: The system must support multiple accounts and categories
tier3_constraints.reasoning: Supporting multiple accounts and categories requires modularity and modifiability to allow easy addition of new account types and categories without affecting existing functionality.

tier3_constraints.constraint_text: Users must be able to generate financial reports
tier3_constraints.reasoning: Report generation features must be learnable and operable by users, with appropriate user error protection to prevent incorrect report parameters or misinterpretation of results.
